visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a beige sweater and white skirt, walks away from the camera along a paved rural road bordered by trees and a traditional building with a blue roof. (2) A couple, a man and a woman in dark aprons, wave enthusiastically in front of a wooden sign that reads 'Hi-COLOR handworks Dyeing Studio.' (3) Close-up of small glass vials and jars containing dark, dried plant material, seeds, and leaves used for natural dyeing. (4) Inside a workshop, a man with long hair in a bun stirs a large vat of dark blue liquid; shelves with containers and a colorful patterned cloth are in the background. (5) Extreme close-up of a pair of hands stained deeply with dark indigo dye, showing the physical toil of the craft. (6) A fluffy calico cat walks through a doorway into the wooden studio environment. (7) Hands are shown washing a white garment in a blue plastic tub filled with water, followed by shots of a person tying and folding white fabric with elastic bands. (8) The woman with stained blue hands submerges a bundled garment into a large vat of dark indigo dye, then rinses it in clear water. (9) The woman opens the lid of a small washing machine, pulls out a pair of leggings with a blue and white tie-dye pattern, and smiles broadly at the camera while holding them up for display.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 我在日本的山裡. (2) [Subtitle]: 認識了一對經營日本藍染工坊的夫婦. (3) [Logo]: Hi-COLOR handworks Dyeing Studio. (4) [Subtitle]: 他們從染料的植物播種開始，全部都是自給自足，並且堅持無農藥的永續農業. (5) [Subtitle]: 用的水是來自富含礦物質的當地清流. (6) [Subtitle]: 藍染染料的製作繁複，發酵的溫度也特別講究. (7) [Variety]: (藍染師傅的雙手). (8) [Variety]: (可愛的梅醬~). (9) [Subtitle]: 從播種到實際染色需要花1年的時間. (10) [Variety]: (新衣服竟然會洗出這麼多洗劑). (11) [Subtitle]: 老闆還說，他為了保持染料的健康，連旅行都不敢去了呢. (12) [Subtitle]: 這是我的第一次體驗藍染，我選了一條 leggings. (13) [Subtitle]: 因為是手工染布，老實說，染出來的樣子其實跟我想像的不太一樣，因為其實...染出來的成果比我想像的要更好看！
